'''Slone''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] who was stationed in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Slone first appeared as a NPC in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he was part of a cut mission on the planet Balmorra that did not even make it into the game's conversation files.
